name: graphite-stack
description: Shows the Graphite stack of your current branch above the Claude Code prompt: stack tree, PR state, review status, open conversations, failing CI and labels, plus a live review page for its diffs.

excludeTests.title: Leave tests out of line counts
excludeTests.description: Count added and removed lines in the band without test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*, __tests__/ and similar).

showGraphite.title: Show 📚 Graphite links
showGraphite.description: Show a link to each PR on Graphite at the end of its row.

showGithub.title: Show 🐙 GitHub links
showGithub.description: Show a link to each PR on GitHub at the end of its row.

githubHost.title: GitHub host
githubHost.description: Your GitHub Enterprise host, for example github.mycorp.com. Leave empty for github.com.

graphiteUrl.title: Graphite URL
graphiteUrl.description: Base address of Graphite for the 📚 links. Leave empty for https://app.graphite.com.
